title: Classification of Quantizations of Symplectic and Poisson Manifolds
exact_target: Classify quantizations of symplectic and Poisson manifolds, including their deformation products.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30003178 (OWR-14743-001). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Topologie (2016), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2016/35, pp. 2009--2068. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 15.
Kontsevich, deformation quantization (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: Formal, strict analytic, geometric and representation-theoretic quantizations are distinct. The broad question does not prescribe one equivalence relation for every such notion, and known formal classifications must not be mistaken for resolution of all requested quantizations.
